//: PRODUCTION-source type-check config for the worker (#533). Extends the build tsconfig, never emits, and scopes to src EXCLUDING __tests__. Deliberately keeps the strict @cloudflare/workers-types-ONLY lib (no @types/node): the worker runs on the pure Workers runtime (no nodejs_compat), so a prod file referencing process/Buffer/node:fs must FAIL here — that's the #532 runtime-crash class this gate guards. rootDir is widened to the repo root so the legitimate cross-boundary import in alerts.ts (api/is-down/region-status.ts) resolves without TS6059 (Phase 3 — this widening, shipped in Phase 1, IS that fix). Test files are checked separately by tsconfig.typecheck.tests.json (which adds node types). scripts/typecheck-worker.mjs runs BOTH passes and, since Phase 4, fails on ANY type error (every code, not just TS2304).
